posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: I received a mail regarding the Mandatory SCT Completion for OPPE Eligibility. It mentions that the SCT Window-1 will be available from September 25th, 12:00 AM to September 28th, 11:59 PM but I am unable to view any such tab in the course portal.

posts.name: Siddharth Bhaumik
posts.cooked:
1. Go to Looker Studio Overview .
  2. Go to - Shared with me.
  3. Go to the tab- Reports
  4. Click on- Student Specific Data.
  5. You should find SCT details along with other data.

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
image2524×1292 293 KB

Can’t see anything like “Student Specific Data”. Also can you link where you got this information from?

posts.name: Siddharth Bhaumik
posts.cooked:
that’s weird. Haven’t you ever gotten a mail like download your admit card or check oppe timing from looker studio?
I got the link from those mails.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: If you cannot see those better mail to support regarding the same.

posts.name: Pammi Tiwari
posts.cooked:
Respected Sir/Ma’am
I have received the mail stating that SCT is not mandatory for me as it was already approved in the previous term. The last time I attended the SCT was in October 2024.

As the form mentioned in the mail is only for willingness, I did not fill it. Since I have not made any changes to my setup, I believe I will be okay to skip it. I just wanted to confirm whether I am required to give the SCT again or it is fine if I don’t attend.

image1430×477 31.3 KB

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: If the word “optional” is written & you are sure your system is OPPE ready then you need not do it again. If you are unwilling to do that you can say “No”.

posts.cooked: I am yet to get gmeet link . how to proceed?

posts.name: Pammi Tiwari
posts.cooked: so is it important to fill the form and say “no” or i can just ignore it ,also the deadline to filling the form is passed

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Check your looker studio and if you don’t find it there mail support regarding that.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: No, its fine. You can leave it.
